summary: On June 17, 2026, BitGo Holdings, Inc., through a Form 8-K and press release, announced a share repurchase program authorized by its board for up to $50M of its outstanding Class A common stock (NYSE: BTGO). Repurchases may occur in open market (subject to Rule 10b-18 volume and pricing conditions), private negotiations, or through Rule 10b5-1 plans. Timing and amount are discretionary, dependent on market conditions. Funding will come from cash and operations. The program can be modified, suspended, or terminated at any time. No fixed expiration, per-share price, or tender offer structure is specified. Watch for execution pace and compliance with 10b-18 safe harbor; this program is a pure open-market repurchase, not a tender, thus no immediate risk-arb spread.
